description: Election Commission - A member of the Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member of That Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares a vacancy in a local authority (Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to be part of their political party (Janasetha Peramuna). This falls under electoral processes and specifically concerns the status of elected members in local government elections, making it a clear Type 7 (Elections) classification under the specialized categories.
